title: [Exploration of the multi-target mechanisms of Shenju Yin in treating sperm DNA damage: An integrated study combining network pharmacology, molecular docking, and dynamics simulation].
authors: Fan, Qian; Chen, Shuo; Qian, Huaying; Zhao, Qi; Xue, Jianguo; Chen, Yun; Zhou, Yuan
journal: Zhonghua nan ke xue = National journal of andrology
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟探索神菊饮治疗精子DNA损伤的多靶点机制，虽涉及蛋白对接和MD，但核心是中药复方药理而非蛋白质结构计算建模，方法为常规应用，对象和问题偏离本课题核心。
abstract: Objective To explore the potential pharmacological targets and mechanisms of action of Shenju Yin, a formula derived from a renowned classic prescription, in treating sperm DNA damage (SDD) by integrating network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation techniques. Methods Potential active ingredients of Shenju Yin were retrieved via the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform (TCMSP) and the Bioinformatics Analysis Tool for Molecular mechanism of Traditional Chinese Medicine (BATMAN-TCM 2.0). Relevant target genes for SDD were identified by cross-referencing the OMIM and GeneCards databases. The Cytoscape 3.10.0 software was employed to construct and visually analyze protein-protein interaction networks and a "disease-target-gene" network. Molecular docking validation of core active ingredients with target protein structures was performed using AutoDockTools-1.5.7. The top three complexes with the strongest binding affinity from docking were subjected to molecular dynamics simulation using Gromacs (2025.2). Results Nine core active components were screened including quercetin, palmitic acid, myristic acid, stearic acid, benzoic acid, myrtenol, kaempferol, luteolin and octanol. Nine core targets including TP53, AKT1, JUN, ESR1, TNF, SRC, IL6, BCL2 and CTNNB1were identified , along with three key pathways such as the Hallmark of Cancer Cell Proliferation Persistence, Gastrin Signaling Pathway and Cancer Pathway. Validation demonstrated strong binding for three complexes: BCL2-luteolin, TP53-kaempferol, and BCL2-quercetin. Conclusion Shenju Yin may treat sperm DNA damage through a multi-component, multi-target, and multi-pathway synergistic mechanism characterized by "antioxidation, mitochondrial stabilization, and apoptosis inhibition." This study provides a scientific basis for the clinical efficacy of Shenju Yin and indicates directions for further experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 目的 通过网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟技术，探讨源自经典名方的参菊饮治疗精子DNA损伤（SDD）的潜在药理靶点及作用机制。方法 通过中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCMSP）和中药分子机制生物信息学分析工具（BATMAN-TCM 2.0）检索参菊饮的潜在活性成分。通过交叉参考OMIM和GeneCards数据库，确定与SDD相关的靶基因。采用Cytoscape 3.10.0软件构建并可视化分析蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络和“疾病-靶点-基因”网络。使用AutoDockTools-1.5.7对核心活性成分与靶蛋白结构进行分子对接验证。将对接中结合亲和力最强的三个复合物使用Gromacs（2025.2）进行分子动力学模拟。结果 筛选出9个核心活性成分，包括槲皮素、棕榈酸、肉豆蔻酸、硬脂酸、苯甲酸、桃金娘烯醇、山柰酚、木犀草素和辛醇。鉴定出9个核心靶点，包括TP53、AKT1、JUN、ESR1、TNF、SRC、IL6、BCL2和CTNNB1，以及3条关键通路，如癌症细胞增殖持续性标志通路、胃泌素信号通路和癌症通路。验证结果表明，三个复合物具有强结合力：BCL2-木犀草素、TP53-山柰酚和BCL2-槲皮素。结论 参菊饮可能通过“抗氧化、线粒体稳定和凋亡抑制”为特征的多组分、多靶点、多通路协同机制治疗精子DNA损伤。本研究为参菊饮的临床疗效提供了科学依据，并为进一步实验验证指明了方向。
